items.text: Kosodi kenyak korot lokorute lokokiŋa loka aiboisnakalaunan, loeseseni kide; ido kegolol.
Katema EJAKAIT eoŋ atiar, “Esalakini erute lo egolol, mam enaario, kwabo emamuun ituŋanan yenelomari, naarai aloma EJAKAIT, Edeke loka Isirael nen; ŋes agolere.
Iboikin ekapolon nen, korai ekapolon, anyamanakin atap nen kakonyen nuka EJAKAIT; elomari korot loka agola nalomaret naka erute, ido elomuni korot ŋopeŋol.”
Kosodi kayana korot lokorute loka agolitomei koinaren ketogo; kasesen, ido koany, kileleba aibuses naka EJAKAIT togo loka EJAKAIT: kebiror ebuburia.

Katema EJAKAIT eoŋ atiar, “Okoku loka etuŋanan, kibwaik ekonitau noi, kosesen kakonikonye, ido kiira kakoniki ŋun kere nukalimokini jo nuka aicorakineta kere nuka etogo loka EJAKAIT, ka ikekisila kere: ido kibwaik ekonitau noi luelomanarete togo, ka luelomanarete da aibois nakalaunan.
Ido ilimonokini lukepali, kes ekek loka Isirael ebe, Inera kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: Wu jo ekek loka Isirael, kodautu italesiakus kere,

naarai itolomununete imo, lumam ekepitai kotauon, ido Iumam ekepitai kawat, ajaut toma aiboisika nakalaunan, amunaar ekatogo, naiinanakiniata ikanyamat, atarion, ka aokot da. Ibilata yesi akaitutuket, aiyatakin italesiakus kere.
Kwabo mam iricito ikaboro lukalaunak: konye ibwaikis yesi imo araut ikaricak akaibois nakalaunan.
“Inera kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: Emamuun emoit lomam ekepitai kotau, ido lomam ekepitai kakuan, loelomari aiboisika nakalaunan, emoit kere loejaunun toma odwe luka Isirael.
Konye Ilebin lualuluasi kamakaŋ, luapaasi kamakaŋ atupar aputosiakec, naapaaria Isirael, ibwokete kesi numam adolitekec.

Konye eraunete kesi ikejaanakinak kotoma aiboisika nakalaunan, aanyanar korutei luka etogo, kijaanakinete da kotogo: earanakinete nul ainakinet naicweio, ka asubanit kanuka ituŋa, ido ebwoenenete kakonyenekec aijaanakin kes.
Ebala Ejakait EDEKE ebe, Naarai kijaanakis kes kakonyen nuka aputosiakec, koraut ekomio kanumam adolit mama ejai ekek loka Isirael; ŋes ekeikinia akakan aluikin kes, ido ibwokete numam adolitekec.

Kwabo mam ikunyunete diekan, aitodol aswam naka esasedoti mamakaŋ, karaida aikunyakin idio koboroka lukalaunak, ka iboro da lukalaunak noi; konye ibwokete ikeceleic, kanuka italesiakee lueswamaenenete,
Konye etuluori kes ikaricak etogo, kanuka aijaanakin kere nakotoma, kanuka akiro kere da nuiswamao kanen.

“Ebala Ejakait EDEKE ebe, Konye isasedotin Ilebin, odwe luka Sadok, luaricenenete akaibois nakalaunan, naapaariata idwe luka Isirael kamakaŋ, nul kes ikunyunete diekan, aijaanakin eoŋ; ebwoete kakonyeneka ainakin eoŋ atarion ka aokot.
Elomanarete kesi aiboisika nakalaunan, ikunyununete omesaka, aijaanakin eoŋ, ido ericete akakiro.
Kosodi kanen naelomanariata orutei luka alaro nakotoma, enapenenete inapen luka ebaputa; kwabo mam enapenenete lukajul, naijaanakiniata korutei luka alaro nakotoma, kotoma da.
Ejaenenas igoen lukieniena luka ebaputa akwesikee, ka epale loka ebaputa kanabesikec; mam enapenenete ibore kere yenisinyinyiri.

Kosodi naelomununiata alaro nakokina, ŋes alaro nakokiŋa naka ituŋa, elacenenete inapenekec luejaanakiniata, kinadakis agolai nukalaunak; kosodete ainap inapen ice, tetere mam italaunete ituŋa kinapenekec.
Ido mam ebarenenete akwesikec, karaida aipit itim; konye enerenenete itimakec.
Mam emasenenei ediosasedoti ebino, naelomariata alaro nakotoma.
Kwabo mam emanyenenete apuserut, karaida naerenearitai; konye komanyenenete abekon nuka aur naka ekek loka Isirael, arai apuserut nakerai apuserut naka esasedoti.
Ido isisianakinete kesi ikatuŋa atiaketait kwape ejaar kidin yenikalaunan ka yenika ituŋa kere, itejenikinete da atiaketait kwape eiaar kidin yenimam elai ka yenelai.
Etubonokinete kesi naeiaatatar ipegeta; etubonokinete kwape ejaatar ikatubesia. Koricito ikakisila ka akaicorakineta opueinoka kere Iuescunitai; kitalaununete da asabatonoka.
Mam ikunyanakinete yenikatwan amunaaror: konye kanuka papa, arai toto, arai ikokukec yenisapat arai yenipese, arai onaee, arai kinaei naemamei ekiliokit, epedorete amunaar.
Ebala Ejakait EDEKE ebe, Kosodi kapaaran naelomaria aibois nakalaunan, alaro nakotoma, aijaanakin aibois nakalaunan, einakini ber ainakineteke naka adiakar.
“Eiaunete kairumet; arai eoŋ airumetekee: kwabo mam iinanakinete alup kotoma Isirael; arai eoŋ alupokec.
Enyamenenete ainakineta nuka akiria, ka ainakineta nuka adiakar, ka ainakineta nuka aronis; ido ŋinibore yenipoliatai koIsirael eraun yenikee.

Ka luegeete kere luka araito kere nugeet, ka ŋiniinakinet kere naka ŋinibore kere, naka ainakinetakus kere, eraununos nuka isasedotin: iinanakinete da isasedotin atapakus nakainumunum, tetere isirerenio ekonitogo.
Mam enyamenenete isasedotin ibore kere yenetwani bon, arai yenepoopootai, arai akweny, arai itiaŋ.
